ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjesaganang lhan zabagg.yon drugan sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags padang/thod pa/ myangan med pa'i shing gisprul ga /tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ gzhu/ rtsegasum rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa'i gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ka bsnams pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mgo skam brgyad kyis dbu brgyan/ mi mge'i do shal dang]rin 4 che dang sprul brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du lha mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas rdo rje dang khab/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa 'odzin pa/sha 'gag ser podangaka stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/rin 4 che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/rdo rje'i skyel krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnyis ka la rnam par snang mdzad ser gas/ kyis dbu brgyan/byag rgya ri/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba la gung mo mnyam par bkug lte/ mtheb chen gnyis skyil mo krung byas/ rtsemo'i tshigs ni cung zad bkug pa dam rgya'o/ /oṃ mā ri dzhai oṃ me hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/mtshan sngags/ oṃ mā ri ②/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang/ /bar du gcod pa kun las grol mdzad cing] /dri med bde ba chen 4 stsol mdzad ma/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so//(29ltog panas byung ba'i 'od zer can ma ser mo gong 'og gnyisani/ tshogs zhing la mtshod bstod/ sdig bshags/ yi rangs/ bsdo ba/ gsesnal gdab/ skyabs 'gyo/ sems bskyed/lam brten pa/ tshad med bzhi rnams byas/ shun+ya tas sbyangs/ mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du nyi ma la oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar 4 byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ zhi ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing] seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ de'i zugs dar phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shang rta la yo las rlung/ rta las sgra gcan zla ba dang nyi ma 'dzin pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i shing rto) steng du padma dang zla ba mesag las 'od zer can sku mdog ser 4 zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ 4zhal seg g.yas dmag g.yon phag pa'i zhal rdzon po zhal re re la spyan gsum gsumadang ldan pa/211
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum/ gaphyag g.yas bzhin/rdo rje/ lcags thi mdag khab/g.yon bzhin/ myangan med pa'isprul ga/gzhu/skud pa/ sdigs mdzub/ gos dmar po'i sha lagagadang stod g.yogs dmar po sgab cing] rin po che'i rgyan dang g.yer kha'i phreng ba'i rkang rgyan can/ de'i shar du beetta liṃ dmar mo phag gi gdong pa can/ phyag bzhi ma phyag gang/sa khab dang lcags thi g.yon zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin pa/sha 'gagadamar po can lhor bad li ser mo phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang khab/ g.yon rdo rje dang zhags pa/ nub tu ba ra li dkar mo phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas rdo rje dang khab/ g.yon zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga /byang du ba ra ha mu khi dmar mo spyan gsum ma/ g.yas rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon zhags padang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang lang tsho dar la babs ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan ba/ g.ye na brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ mā ri ② rmā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ mtshan sngagasadang bstod pa 'dra'o//(3༷ltog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer tshogs zhing la mchod pa sogs/ can dkar mo ni/ shun+ya tas sbyangs/ mchod rten gyi nang du pad zla la me las 'od zer can dkar mo zhal lnga/ phyag brga zhabs bzhi ma/ 4zhaladakadagayasanag/g.yon gyi phag gi gdong padamar ṭo can/ rgyab zhal ljang/ lteng zhal ser ba/ phyag g.yas lnga na nyi ma'i dkyil pangogardo rje sngon po/mdagalcags ma khab/g.yon ljan zla ba'idakyil gangodagazhu/ myangan med pa'isprul ga/sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa skud pa rnams 'dzin pa/rin 4 che'i rgyanadang dril bu g.yer ga'i phreng bas rked brgyan cingaka sha 'gag dang stod g.yogs dkar 4 can/ phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta) steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis zhabs bzhis khyab 'jug dang] dbang po dang]bde byed dang] tshangs pa rnams mnan pa/ de'i mdun du shing rta de nyid la gnas pa'i chu srin gyi steng du ltamo phag zhal can nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub/ g.yas 212
bar brgya rtsa'i rjesaganang gi lhan sasogphyogs su lha mo phag zhal can dmar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas lcags kyu dang khab/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags ba dang skud pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon phyogs su lha mo phag zhal can dmar mo phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa/ 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dngad mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'odzin pa/ gsum ka'ang rin 4 che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ g.yosnan brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa shing rta 'dren pa'i phag gi 'og na nyi ma la thegags pa'i gza' dgu dang] nyer 'tshe byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs mi'i gzugs kyis gnas pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyisadabu brgyan/ sngags/ mtshan sngags bstod pa 'dra// (31)myangan med pa'i 'od zer can ni/phag ser po'i rgyab tu padma dang zla ba la me las 'od zer can ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sgyin dang g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ rigs rnam bar ga mas bdag 'dra/ oṃ mā ri ṭwāṃ me swāhā/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra/ (32)mo ḍa ya na'i rim pa'i 'od zer can ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gus bla re/ ye shesakyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i gshor lo'i nang du shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskyor ba'i dbus su mo ḍi ya na'i ngo 'o chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dkar la dmar ba'i nang du nyi ma la hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las lha mo 'od zer can sku mdog dmar mo/zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma/ rtsaba'i zhaladamar mo/g.yas su ser podang nag po'i zhal gnyis/g.yon du dkar 4 dnganag po'i zhal gnyis/ steng du phag pa'i zhal nag 4 re re'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag bcu gnyis skya g.yas pa drug na/ ral sgra/ sna tshogs rdo rje/rdo rje rtsegacig pa/ dgra lta mdag gtun shing / g.yon pa drug gis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas khab/ rtsegasum/ mya ngan med pa'i yal ga /gzhu/ zhags pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo 'o 213
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum/ garnams bedzin pa dbu skra kham ser gyen du brjes pa/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang / sprul dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ ha ha zhes drag tu rgod cing bdud bzhi mnan pa'i stengan zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra dhā tī shā ri sarba duṣṭan ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ oṃ mā ri ② māṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra bee tā li hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mā ri ṭwāṃ/ oṃ rmā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra/ (33) tsunda ni/ tshogs zhing la phyag 'tshal/ mtshod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs kyis sems bskyed/ shun+ya tadang sābhā was sbyangs/ pad zla la rtsu las lha mo bskul byed ma/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang po mchog sbyon/ g.yon dang pos pad dkar gyi steng na sher phyin gyi po hi/ 'og ma gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas phyag rgyas/ snying ga /smin mtshams/ mgrin pa/ sgyi 'o rnams su srung ba bya/ phyag rgya ni/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba las/ sdigs mdzub gnyis kyi gung mo dkyil du dbyil ba'i tshul du sbyar zhing mazeb chen gnyis logs su bcer ba'o/ /oṃ tsa le tsu le tsunde swāhā/ mtshan sngags ārya tsanda/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ mkhyen ba4nus /hā/tsho ṭwāṃ/la/ snro3 rdzu (5pa parnyi dītta dzño staXsto/ lha/ ( ma/( ༈ shā/ ghnā kṣiṃ rnyi dwo/da/ ༷༷ ( yig yongs su gyur pa las dzambha la ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bī dza pū ra dang g.yon rin po che'i char 'babs pa'ini'u le 74na pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis dungadang padma'i gter mnan pa/ /utpal sngon po'i phreng ba dang] rin 4 che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gtso 'or gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings/ gung mo 214
ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjesaganangagi lhan thabs/dag dbus ma'i tshigs gsum spru bkug pa ni dzambha la'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ dzambha la dza lent+ra ya swāhā/mtshan sngags/ ārya dzambha la/ nor gyi dbang rgyug sogs/ (35)dzambha la u 4tshe ni/ pad zla la hūṃ las dzambha la sku mdog nag po mi'u zung gi gzugs can/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rna ba ma phug pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ klu chen 4 brgyad kyis brgyan pa/g.yas thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang/ g.yon na rin 4 che sna tshogs skyug pa'i ne'u le 'edzin pa/g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyisanor bdag ser po'i khanas rin 4 che phyugs pa mnan pa/rin chen 'byung ldan gyisadabu brgyan/ mtshan sngags bstod pa 'dra/ (36)nor rgyun ma ni/ pad zla la baṃ las lhameXstor rgyun ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang/g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis char 'phebs pa'i bum pa 'edzin pa/ rin 4 che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mdza' ba'i skye 'gro rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings te gung mo gnyis kyis tshigs gsum pa bcag pa ni nor rgyun ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ shrī ba su ṅka na kṣe tree swāhā/ mtshan sngags/ ba su dhi rī/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma/ /dpal dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma/ /yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma/ /bsam 'phel dkyil dngor dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /ces so/ /(37)khro gnyer can ni/ pad zla la kṣiṃ las lha mosna kho gnyer can/ sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/g.yas mtshog sgyin dang phreng ba/ g.yon dbyug pa dang ril ba sgyi blugs 7)na pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can cung zad khro zhing zhi ba/ sems dpa'i skyel krung gis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ lag pa gnyis brkyang ste mazeb chen gyis maze'u chung gi sen mo lhag ma so sor bya ba ni rdo rje'i mtshan nyid do/ /khro gnyer can gyi dam rgya/ 6 3swāhā/ mtshan sngags/ ārya 1 ku ḍi/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 215
kun mkhyenagasung 'bug gasogs sgyi bstod bya'o/ /(39)byams mgon ni/ pad zla la peṃ las rje btsun byams pa mgon po zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa/ khur kum gyi mdog can/ phyagadang po chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/g.yas 'og mas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon 'og mas klu shing gi yal ga me rtog dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsumadang ldan pa/ zhi ba'i rgyan dngan bza' can/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul ba du ma 'gyo ba/ semasadapa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs spru/lda ྅ sems dbasadabu brgyan/ lag gnyis so sodag nyug /khu tshur bcings te sdigs mdzub gnyis/ /maze bo'idabus su bzhag bya ste/ /me rtog rnam par mchod par sga /phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ peṃ me tris swāhā/mtshan sngags/ ārya dku tri/ byams chen me yis sogs/ (39)gur gyi sher phyin ni/ pad zla la oṃ las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin bdakar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/g.yas padmadang g.yon po ti 'odzin pa/ dbu skra phyed du i ba/ rgyan dang na bza' bzhugs tshul 'dra/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ nda tsu tra tsu bradzñā brta'i dzā la dzā la me rda brta ni/ lha ri lha ri buddha baddha ni swāhā/ mtshan sngags/ ārya bradzñā pa ra nata/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /sogs/ (40)gdan bzhidang sa( ṭa las gsungs pa'i sher phyin ni/padadakaradang zla ba la phroṃ las sher phyinadakar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis padma gnyis kyi stengan sher phyin gyi poti re re bedzin ba/ rgyan yas cho kyi/ dang na bza' snatshogs/ rigs bdag 'dra/ rdo rje'i skyel krung gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ smaṃ swāhā/oṃ bras mahā bras hūṃ phaṭa hūṃ swāhā/ /oṃ bras mahwa bras hūṃ swāhā/ ñtsa gzhung na sngags 'di gnyis mi rog/pa( rsha /pa rnyi pang zlohā dī sna zla/dzā kṣiṃshā rnyi tshi ༵ ñtsā lcu shlau shā /pa lha/lha dīlha /gañdzashā ṭwāṃ g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ g.yon pas pad gron gyi lteng du sher phyin gyi po ti bsnams pa/rgyanadangan bza' sna tshogs/ rigs bdag 'dra/ rdo rje'i skyel krung gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ bras mahā 216
ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjes gnangagi lhan thabagbras shu ti smri ti tra dza ya dhīsgasnahā/ oṃ bhiḥshu ti smri ti bi dza ya swāhā/ mtshan sngags bstod pa 'dra/(42)yang sher phyin ser mo dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gser mdog can gyi sher phyin gnyis la/gzhan thams cad de dang 'dra ba las/ phyag gnyis nas utpala'i lteng na sher sgyin gyi po ti re re 'odzin pa/ 9lta ༷snyiX/ swāhā/ (43)bar 'dir sher min ma ser mo ldon ma dang 'dra ba la/ sngags/spri phru ༷// ṭwāṃ ༷/ shī shaṃ /spya/ ṭwāṃ ༷ ṭwāṃ / ༷༷ ༷༷༷ ༷༷ shes sgyuX shlau shaṃ bloX ༷/ dkar sodang nyi ma la hūṃ las rje btsun mi g.yo ba gron po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral sgra nam mkhar 'phyar zhing] g.yon zugs lngar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags spru 'dzin pa/dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gnyis dang ldan pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ dbu skra nag po'i thor tshugs can/ mgo bo'i zeng bas dbu brgyan/ rin ṭo che'i rgyan dang sprul dkar po'i mchod phyir thogs kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gasku'on pa'i pus mo dang g.yas pa'i rting ba gdan la btsugs te bzhengs ma stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer dmar po'i 'tsheng ba 'phyo ba/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ tsanam hwa ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ arya a tsa la/ mye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyangaka /sogs/ (45)rdo rje hūṃ mdzad ni/ padma dang nyi ma la hūṃ mdzad nag 4 zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs gar 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa spra/ sra shā /pa ༵ /ṭā ༵ shāshāspru lam ༈sna (rgyas rdzuzlo/ ༷ ṭwāṃ papa zlo( sharnyi rdzu( rnyi nā/sna dzño mtshan sngags/ kro 5 rā dzā hūṃ kā ga 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra sogs/ (46)ri khod lo ma can ni/ pad 217
kun mkhyenagasung 'bug gadkar zla ba la paṃ las lha mo ri khod ma ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ gzhal seg g.yas dkad g.yon dmas re re la'ang spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ 'aying zhing bzhad pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na/rdo rje/ dgra lta mda'/ g.yon gsuman sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/shing lo gsar ba'i sbrang yab gzhu rnams bedzin pa/ metog gis bcings pa'i ral pa'i cod pan/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing/shing lo gsar ba'i sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas pa'i nying bas 'og sgo bkag cing / g.yon pa'i zhabs mazil stan la btsugs te bgegs kyi steng na bzhugs pa/ sku la nyi ma'i dkyil gangor ltabu'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ nda shā tsi parṇa sha pa ri sarba mār blo sha ma ni swāhā/ mtshan sngags/ ārya parṇa sha pa ri/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /zhes sogs/ (47)dgra nag nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can ma ni/tshogs zhing la/ mtshod phyag /bshags pa/ yi rangs/ skyabs las/ smon lam rnams sga shun+ya tas sbyangs/ pad zla ladoyig las rdo rjedabyangs can ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ 4zhaladamar sed g.yas sngon 4/ g.yon dkar po/ phyag g.yas gsuman padma/ ral sgra/ sgra gug / g.yon gshor lo/ rin po che/thod pa 'odzin pa/ rin 4 che'i rgyan dngadar gyin bza' can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs ba/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ tra tsu pi tsu bradzñā brta ni/ dzā la dzā la me ha brta ni/ nyi ri nyi ri burnyi balha ni swāhā/ mtshan sngags/ badzra swa ra swa snyi/rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yis/ /rnam par 'phrul bas dpal las legs 'ongs shing] /sgrub ba 4 ladangos grub mtshog nyer ma/ /ltamo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs/ (48)bgegs mthar byed ni/ tshogs zhing la/ mchod/ phyag /sdigs bshags/ skyabs 'gro rtsogs sgashucahas sbyangs/ paṃ las padmadangs las nyi ma la hūṃ las bgegs mthar byed sku mdog sngon bo zhalagacig phyagaganyis ba g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 7)na cing/g.yon 218
ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjesaganangalha lhan thabagzugs spur sdigs mdzubadang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum rshadī snri dī/ mp+raṃ snam snashā na/ dri dzño ṣṭaṃ/ṭwāṃ snyi dwo ༷/rsha sprapa gyipa pa'i dī/༵༵ pa/sna bshā sna/shā zhi kri sta ༈//paji dzño nd+ra (sdu hūṃ/ dīdzā dzño ṭwāṃ rtswa hūm̐ lha/lha ṭwāṃ/ ryaṃ lhalha snashā spya /spya /snag/ chorsha) bzhi ma/ dang 4 gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa zugs dar 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral sgra/g.yon 'og mas utpal 'dzin spru/ spyan gsumadang ldan zhing mche ba ga6gas pa/dbu 7kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ nu 'bur rgyas shing gsus ba 'phyang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can//sna ༷dī hūm̐ /lha ṭwāṃ shuddhi dī ṅgi]/shā spyan tshozlo paX kṣiṃ dzño sa dzño dzño /dhi baXspya ghnā/ sngags/ ārya e ka dza ṭi/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thegags sgyi bstod sga (5༷)dug sel ma ni/pad nyi la nāṃ las 'phags ma dug sel ma ser mo zhal gsum ma/ sprul mabasto ser po'i gdengs ka bdunadang ldan zhing] spyan gsum mnga' ba/ zhal 'dzum zhing khro ba/ phyag drug gi g.yasan rdo rje/ ral gri /gar gyi tshul gyi mda'/ ga'atshen sdigs mdzub dang bcas ba'i zhags pa/ dug gi me tog gron 4/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ me rtog dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ phyag rgya ni/ lag pa gnyis kyis sprul gyi gdengs da'i rnam pa'i sgyi 4ra gdengs ka gdugs ltabur byas pa dug sel ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa'i sor mo lnga kha zur bstan pa'i steng du g.yas khu tshur byas pa'i maze 'ong dang maze'u chung brkyang lte gdengs ka bdun gyi tshul byasate/ rang gi sbyi 'or bzhag pa'o/ /yon maḥsha ra ba ra ku mā rī tsunri tsa hi tsa las/ tsu lamo/ selha ṭa'i/ mahwa mnyadi/ a ha/ bde aṅge/ oṃ ṭwāṃ swāhā/ mtshan sngags/219
kun mkhyenagasung 'bum/ gaārya ṭwāṃ gu li/ sgyi bstod bya/ (51)rigs byed dkar dmar ni/ tshogs zhing la mchod bstod sogs/ pad nyi la ṭwāṃ las rje btsun ma ku ru kulle sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang 4 gnyis kyisa.utpa la'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs shingadagayas 'og ma mi 'dzigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang] g.yon 'og mas utpal 'dzin pa/ rin 4 che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing dar dmar po'i stod g.yogasadang sham thabs can/ gdod pa'i lha chung ma dang bcas pa'i steng du rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ ku ru kulle swāhā/ mtshan sngags/ ārya ku ru kulle/ brtseba'i rjes chags padma rā ga'i mdog/zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /mda' gzhu utpal mi 'jigs phyag rgya can/ /bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /(52ltog pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kulle ni/ tshogs zhing la/ mchod pa/ phyag 'tshal ba/ bshags pa/ yi rangs/ bldo ba/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ tshad med rnams bya/shun+ya tas sbyangs/ pad dmar dang zla ba la hrīḥlas rig byed ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og ma mi 'dzigs pa'i phyag rgya/g.yon 'og mas utpal dmar 4 'dzin pa/ rin 4 che'i rgyan dang dar dmar po'i na bza' can/'od zeradamar ṭo 'phro ba/ rig byed kyi phugan/ sgra gcan mgo bo la gnas pa'i gdod pa'i ltachung ma dang bcas pa'i steng na g.yon brkyang ba'i skyel krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya 'dis ye shes pa bcug /phyag rgya ni thal mo skyar la/ gung mo gnyis rtsemor byas la/ srin lag gnyis nang du bcug /mdzub mo gnyis gung po'i rgyab tu sbyag mthe 'ong gnyis phyed 'og tu byas pa ni utpa la'i phyag rgya'o/ /'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ ku ru kullehrīḥnu swāhā/ mtshan sngagasadang bstod pa 'dra/ /(53)sgrol ma mngon 'byunganas 'byung ba'i lha mo rig byed mni/ gzhan rnams gong bzhin las/ phyag dang po gnyisa.utpa la'i mda' gzhu/ g.yas 'og mas mchog sgyin/220
ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjesaganang gi lhan pasagoṃ ku ru kulle sgyuX hūṃ swāhā/ bstod tsheg rkang pa gsum pa/ mda' gzhu utpal mchog sbyin phyag rgya can/ /zhes sogs brjod/ (54)mo ḍi yana'i rig byed ma dang] 'og nas byung ba'i rig byed ma ni/ tshogs zhing la/ mtshod ba/ phyag 'tshal/ bshags pa/ sems bskyed/ tshad med/ shucahas sbyangs/ pad nyi la hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ me ri dang bcas pa'i bsrung pa'i gshor lo'i dbus su e'i rnam pa'i chos 'byungadakar dmar gyi nang du 〉phyos byung ba'i padmadamar sa 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bag 8 las nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la gyiphyos rje btsun ma ku ru kulle sku mdogadamar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'idang po gnyis kyisa.utpa la'i mda' gzhu/g.yas 'og masakha.aladamar po las byas pa'i lcags kyu dang] g.yon 'og mas utpaladamar po'i steng na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/dbu skukham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam 4sadabu brgyan/rlon pas do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cingaka stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/'odadabag med kyisadabu brgyan/ oṃ ku ru kulle gyiḥswāhā/ mtshan sngags/ ārya ku ru kuṇḍa/ bstod pa'i tshig rkang gsum spru/mda' gzhu utpal dbang gi lcags kyu bsnams/ /zhes brjod/ gzhan 'dra/ (55)khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs ni/ lug gnyis zhags pas sbrel ba'i steng du pad nyi la gyiphyos khams gsumadabang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs sku mdogadamar 4 zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i zhags pa dngad g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sprul pa sna tshogs 'phyo zhing / rdo rje'i skyel spung gis bzhugs pa/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyisadabang bskur ba/ byang chub semasadapa' rnams kyis mchod pa byed pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang khyab 'jugadang/ bde byed dang rdzal 'gyor ma'i tshogs 221
kun mkhyenagasung 'bum/ gakyis gar dang] sil snyan brdung gabrol byed/ 'byung po'i tshogs mi'i mgo 'o dang keng rus la sogs pas brgyan pa du mas gdugasadang rnga yab la sogs pas bkur stir byed pa'i lubor gyi tshogs du mas bskor ba/'odadapag med kyis dbu brgyan/ gyiḥ/lta5athi+-itshan sngags/3 lo kya ba shaṃ ka ra lo zhi shwa ra sa pa ri wā da dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs sgyi bstod sga (56) gang ba bzang po'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i dpal gnod gnas gshor bcas ni/ thabs dang shes rab kyingo 'o zla ba dkar dmar yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la baṃ yig las lha mo nor rgyun ma/ shar du bzang mo/ lhor rab tu bzang mo/ nub tu sbas ma/ byang du rab tu sbas ma/shar lhor ltamo/ snyo nub tudabyangs can ma/ nub byang du 'phags ma/ byang shar du zla shel can ma rnams sku mdog ser mo/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ rin 4 che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyel krung gis bzhugs pa/gtso mo'i lha ga'i nang du gzhalalas khang gi dbus su dzi las dpal gnod gnas sku mdog ser 4 zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/g.yas nda dza pū ra zhadang] g.yon rje'u le 'edzin pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis dungadang padma'i tshogs kyi gter mnan zhing/ rin 4 che'i char 'bebs pa/ utpal sngon po'i phreng pa can/ nor rgyun ma ser mo 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems pyir 'phyos pa/rin po che'i tshogs nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par gyur te sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las gnod sgyin chen po bcu drug tu gyur te/shar du gang ba bzang po gron 4/ lhor rnam zos sras ser po/ nub tu gnod sbyon dmar po/ byang du nor bu bzang 4 ser po/ shar lhor ci bi kuṇḍale dmar po/ lho nub 6rol pa'i zeng ba sngon 4/ nub byang du spyod pa'idabang po ser po/ byang shar du sgo'idabang po ser po ste thams cad kyang tra dza bhu ra ka dang ne'u le 7)na pa/ shar sgor gnod sbyin dang gnod sgyin 222
ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjesaganangagi lhan 4gachen 4/ snyo sgor padmadang padma chen 4/ nub sgor ka tpa dang gi rla chen 4/ byang sgor gang ba dang kārsha dī kṣiṃ ༵ ( sbyo /dripa ca( ghnā ༵ lha dzño kli rnghi/ 〉( rdu dzo )(( ṅgi ༵༵ ba ༵/ ṭwāṃ ṭhaṃ che ṭwāṃ dzambhal dza lenaya swāhā/ oṃ ba su rnyi ri 3 swāhā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ dzambhalas pa ri wā ga gang ldon lha)sna/ ༵ ༵ )spra pas/pa rnyisna /rnam/ṭwāṃ ༵ tt+waṃ trī ༵ tshi ༵ ṭā shā ༵༵/spyu (ma ༷ ghnā sgrol ma ni/ gong gi ral gcig ma dang gcig par snang yang / rjes gnang zur tu mdzad pas/ shu n+ya tas skyangs/ pad nyi la ṭaṃ las rje btsun ma sgrol ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang 4 gnyis kyis sgra gugadang thod pa thugs nar 'dzin pa/g.yas 'og mas ral sgra/ g.yon 'og mas utpal/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ nu 'bur rgyas shing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /thod pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/6 3oṃ hūṃ phaṭa mtshan sngags/ ārya༄ ga'agro ba'i 'jigs pa'i nyes pa bskyab pa'i phyig /brtsebas 'jigs byed lha mo'i skur bstan ba/ /dbugs 'byin mdzad cing dngos grub mchog stsol ma/ /sgrol ma drag mos 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes theg/ / (58)guranas byung ba'i lda ྅ sgrol ma 'i/ padma dang nyi ma'i lteng du hūṃ yig las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gud bla re/ ye shes kyi me 'bar bdang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i dngor lo'i nang du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la taṃ las rdo rje sgrol ma ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ 4zhal sed g.yasanag/g.yonadamag rgyabadakar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhin/ rdo rje/ mda'/ dungan mtshog sgyin/223
kun mkhyen gsung 'bugakhogg.yon bzhin utpal/ gzhu/ lcags kyu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/shar du oṃ las me tog sgrol ma dkar mo me tog /lhor tā las bdug spos slol ma nag mo spos snod/ nub tu re las mar me sgrol ma ser mo mar me/ byang du tu ta las dri'i sgrol mdamar mo dung chos/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la shar lhor gsor lo/ lho nub tu rin 4 che/ nub byang du padma/byang shar du ral sgra/ shar sgoratā las lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags ma lho sgor re las zhags pa ma nag mo zhags pa/ nub sgor tu las lcags slog ma ser mo lcags sgog /byang sgor re las dril bu mdamar po dril bu/ steng du swā las gtsugator rnam rgyal ma ser mo gshor lo/'og nyuhā las gnod mdzes ma nag mo sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ thams cad phyag ga〈snan pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing khro ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ rdo khu'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'o la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur ba'i rigs lnga dang/ shar phyogs pa rnams la rnam snang/ lho phyogs pa la rin 'byung] nub phyogs pa la 'od dpag med/ byang phyogs pa la don grub/ lteng phyogs pa la rnam snangaka 'og gi phyogs la 'odadapag med kyisadabu brgyan/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na masmurya a wa lo gi te shwa ra ya/ ba sgyi sa twa la/ mahwa sa3 la/ mahā rpā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ trī re tutta re tu ṇḍa gcigan ga re sarba duṣṭa ma lha dzo te: ṭwāṃ kṣiṃ tu/ṭwāṃ dṛ ṭwāṃ lhahā/ /dzosna/ ryaṃ/rgyu/lha/ ( rtswa dī spri ༵ /gas/ tsā pa lta/ ṭwāṃ kham̐ ༵ ༵ sangs rgyas sogs kyis sbyo bstod sga (59)gshedadamarani/ tshogs zhing la bshags pa bya runganpaṃ las padmadang yaṃ las nyi ma la hūṃ las gshin rje'i gshed dmar 4 zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/g.yas mi mgo rlon pa ser 4sa mtshan pa'idabyug padakar 4 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing/g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la dbyud pa/ zhal mche ba gamigs 224

rnamasrasagacigalhag lngacagon gsum gyi tshab bsgrigaglan gsum brjod/ rdo rje 'chang] phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying phyo sogs rtsab dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dkar 4 tshe 'phel gtso gabor khyed rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di la las zhing mchis pa dang bsrung skyob sba gsum mdzad du gsol/ 'di'i bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing / tshe dang brtsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel te sku tshe dang bzhed don mthar phyin pa 'byung ba'i 'phrin las dang sdongs grogs mdzad du gsol/ rnam sras kyis kyang de ltar zhal gyis bzhes te 'od du zhu slob ma'i sbyi 4 nas rim par bsam la/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho brjod/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs 'dra/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rnam sras kyi rten la/ su blo tiṣṭhas brtan bzhugs sga gang sku zla shel mkha' 'dir shar ma thag /'chi bdag bdud sde'i mun pa sa 'og bros/ /'chi med 'od zer 'bum phrag phyogs bcur 'phro/ /lha khyod snying gi thig ler rtag bzhugs gsol/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang phyag na rdo rje/ gyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ grub chen snying ka ra ti/ kha che dgon pa pa/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/ g.yor bo jo ston/ sprul ti dgra bcom pa/ mkhan chen shes rab seng ge /bsam yas pa tshul khrims dbang phyug/se ba can paphunan tan tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ des mkhan chen ka bzhi pa dang/ dga' ldan phugs pa bla ma 'gro ba gnyis la gnang]de gnyis ka la mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsan/ de nas shākya mchog ldan/ brag dmar ba kun dga' chos 'phel/ spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen tshos kyi rgyal 4/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen ban des rje bla ma/ yang tshar chen/ mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos rgya mtsho/ dbang snyog rab brtan/ ngag dbang chos grags man sngar ltar ro/ /289
kun mkhyen gsung 'bu'abu ga(14)gartsol ba btab pas 'dod dgu ma lus pa/ /'byung bar ma zad mi mthun dgra bo'i dbung / /lasdoms mdzad dgra lha chen 4 sprin gseb mag /grags pa'i ser chen lha dgu e ma rmad/ /ltasas dang blon 4 zhang ltabazang kludapal gnyis kyis lha da hor gyi sgom grwa 'groms pa'i dmag la 'gro skabs tsheg rgyan chen pos gnang ba'i zhi drag gnyis las zhi ba ljang yul ma'am/sprin gseb ma ser chen lha dgu gong non phyag rdor badzra pā ṇi dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang la/'di'i phyag bzhes la/ phyag rdor la gtor ma/ tshom bu bum par dri bzang gi chu rdor gzungs kha rgyanadang bcas pa/ rnam sras la rten gtor khang bzang ma/ 'bul gtor mchod pa rnams dkyus bzhin dang / rjes gnang gi skabs su dgos pa'i phyag mtshan rgyal mtshan dang ne'u le 'bur ma'am/ bris pa tsa ka las kyang go chod pas de rnams bshams/ slob dasan rang nyid ltan bde ba la 'dug nas mtshod pa byin rlabs ma skyabs 'phro sems bskyedadzin lag bdun pa/ swa bhā was stong nyid bsgom pa sgyi ltar sga stong pa'i ngang las ri rab kyi steng gzhal yas khang gi nang du padma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / nyi ma zla ba'i steng du rang sems kyi ngo 'o hūṃ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la rim pa las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon pa zugs dar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs 'dangs su rdzogs pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum ga〈snan brkyang bas ye shes kyi me rshadīpa dzño ༵༵ ༵༵ sprigapa sna/sa (lha dī /tha/sna zlo shā /( /sna ( zlosnrosna (mi /phredzo /pa bskor ba la dmigs nas/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ ci nus bzla/ bum par yang phyag na rdo rje bskyed pa nas ye shes pa bsnyim pa'i bar 'gre/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod gtor ma bsngo/290
rnam༄khagacinalhag lngatsogagasuyogyi tshag bsgrigagsnying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bum nang gi lha la phog sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung ba sogs 'dra/ mdun gyi rten gtor ladamigs te/ a krahas bsangs/swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las ṭwāṃ las gzhal yas khang khang brtsegs rim pa gsum dang bcas pa'i steng mar rtsabargyud kyi bla ma rnams bzhugs/ bar na phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs/ 'og na seng ge'i rṇi steng du bai las 'od zer 'jus/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul 'phongs zhi bar byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal 4 chen 4 rnam thos sras sku gser gyi mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rin 4 che'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ g.yon na rje'u le'i rkyal ba 'dzin pa/ rin 4 che'i cod ban dbu la mnab pa/ gzhan yang rin po che'i rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan do shal dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub 'pheng ba can/ zhal nas rin 4 che'i char 'beebs pa/ phrag gong g.yas su nyi ma dang / g.yon du zla bas mtshan pa/gsus khyim che la zhabs skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du dzam bha la ser 4 rin po che thogs pa/ lhor gang ba bzang 4 ser 4 rgyal mtshanadang bum pa 'ogs pa/ nub tu nor bu bzang 4 rin 4 che 'bar ba thogs pa/ byang du ku bee ra nag 4 gos nag phyon zhing dar nag thogs pa/ shar lhor yang dag shes ser po ral sgra thogs pa/ snyo nub tu 'brog gnas nag so dar mdung thogs pa/ nub byang du lngas rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs thogs pa/ byang shar du bi 6 kunanda khu7ra 4 sgra phub thogs pa/ thams cad kyang phyag g.yon na rje'u le bsnams shing] rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rta la chibs pa/ mgo brnyan snatshogs yod pa'i gnod sgyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsams/ rang nyid phyag rdor du gsal ba'i thugs na'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ byang phyogs nas rnam sras gargar bcas spyan drangs par bsam la/ dril bu gsil/ hūṃ ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs nas/ /gnod sgyin chen 4 rnam thos 291
kun mkhyenagasung 'bug gasras/ /'khor gyi gnod sbyin tshogs dang bcas/ /zugs dam bskangs shing gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya smiX caḥdzaḥdzaḥ.au bai swāhā/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥ: tra gas mdun bskyed la bstim/ oṃ ratna mu ku tra a lha ṣiñtsa me/ oṃ āḥ// hūṃ gsang bdag gnod sgyin chen 4 dngor bcas la/ /slosadang me rtog mar me zhal zasangangad /sil snyan rnga dang smyugs pa mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dngos su 'gyor dang yid kyis sprul pas mchod/ /a /25/ pa〉/ du pe/ ā lo ke/ ga)/ nai wi bya/ shaltashu dza me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pas mchod/ gzhan gyis mi thub dgra rnams 'dzoms/ /lha min g.yul rnams pham par mdzad/ /rgyal po chen 4 rnam thos sras/ /lubor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces gshor bcas bstod/ 'bul gtor la dmigs te/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'ingang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i bdud ji'i rgya mtsho chen por dmigs la/ shā a kā ro mu khaṃ sesnags kyi mthar/ phyug āḥ: btags la lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la mtshan sngags mthad mahwa ba liṃ ta mahwa ñtsā dza khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis phul/mdun bskyed kyi zugs sgar bai dang ṭwāṃ sogs dmigs la/'od zer gyi 'phyo 'dus don byas par bsam la/ oṃ bai swāhā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes pa brgya la 〈snags pa bzla/ shāg dzam lha la ye swāhā/ oṃ purṇa snya tra ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ku bee ra ye swāhā/ oṃ saṃ pradzñā na ye swāhā/ oṃ gu hye tha na ye swāhā/ oṃ panyi ka ye swāhā/ oṃ pi 6 kuṇḍali swāhā/ zhes pa rnams bdun la sogs pa bzla/ de nas slob ma khus byas phyag phul gral la lubod la/ 'o sems can thams cad skya zhes sesnags mtshams skyar nas/ gsan par bya ba'i chos ni rnam sras sprin gseb mar grags pa'i rjes su gnang ba yin la/ 'di'i lo rgyus lha sras mya rṇi btsan 4 dgung lo nyi shu rtsalnga lon pa'i dus yab rgyal pos byang phyogs gyi dgra thams cad 'dul ba la lha sras dmag dngon du bskos 292
rnam sras gcig lhag lngacagatagasum gyi tshag bsgrigagannas 'byon dgos par bka' stsal pa na lha sras kyis tshogs gtor rgya chen po rnams bshams nas/ slobadapon chen 4 padma 'byung gnas la 'di skad ces zhus so/ /bdag byang phyogs su ging shing gi yul khams khri dan rgya dang phyogs thams cad du dmag dpon la bskos nas gtod par gda' bas bdag dngadamag sne thams cad kyi tshe srog la bar chad med pa dang/ phyogs kyidagra thams cad shulanasalab rgyal po'idagongs paphunangs su rdzogs padang phyogs thams cad du bkrashisadang bde legs 'byung ba'i rten 'brel rgya chen 4 gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slobadapon chen pos de ltar bya'o gsungs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong bar byed pa'i rgyal 4 chen po rnam thos sras gsor gnod sgyin rta bdag brgyad man brnyan sna tshogs yod pa'i gnod sgyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin gseb tu spyan drangs/ rgyal 44ba sras dngoradang bcas pa la zhal mngon sum du bstan/ slobadapon chen pos rgyal bu 'di'i lus dang grib ma bzhin 'phyogs la bdag gis ji ltar brjod pa bzhin du 'phrin dhri (rdzu dzādzā tshir/ ༷༵༵ sprisdu mi / snrosnro snrosna lhadzo rsha shā ryaṃ paXs ṭwāṃ /ji smirnyi ༵༵ shāshā rab gnas mnga' gsol mdzad/ rgyal po'i bladar du grags/ denas mnga' 'og gidamag thams rsha) ༷pa spyad/sprisna pa/ ṭā spya sna(rdzu shāshāng ༵ lha shādri lhan༈ sna ༵ ༷hā shā ༵༵༵ sprid(lha ༵༵ bzhugs te 'phyar dar chen 4 'phyad rgya zam gcig la dmag grangs su btabanas bshar bas/shar phyogs bya khra'i rgyal khams kyi dmag yin zer ba lus mi la mgo bya khra'i gdong ba yod pa dar re'i rjes la rṇi tsho re 'brang ba dar tsho dgu byung/ lho phyogs grul bum rkang rtse'i rgyal khams kyidamagasan zer ba ro stod mi la rta 'ong gi rkang sugayod padar re'i rjes la rṇi tsho 'brang bdar 293
kun mkhyen gsung 'a49na gatsho bcubyung] nub phyogs byi la'i mjug ma can gyi rgyal khams skya dmag yin zer ba mi'i lus la byi la'i mjug ma yod pa dar re'i rjes la khri tsho re 'brangs padar tsho bcu gnyis byung] byang phyogs rna 4 che song bu'i rgyal khams skya dmagayin zer ba lus mi la 'ong bu'i rna ba yod pa dar re'i rjes la khri tsho re 'brangs pa dar tsho bcu gsum byung / 'di rnams phyogs bzhi so so nas yongs pa'i dmag yin palang srid mod/ phal cher ni mgo brnyan sna tshogs yod pa'i gnod sbyin /sna ṭwāṃ lha( bsta ༵༵ calha snyi dī kṣiṃ/ ༵ ༵ dzño ༵ /spyarnarmi ༵ shātnakāX spriX sbri rmyo sbyipa denasadamag drangasate gru gudang] rgyanag gi rgyal khams thams cad btul/ hor gyi sgom grwa bar ma bcomanas 'cham sku bse 'bagadamar sa gdan drangs/nor rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa khyegslar ltabazang kludapal dmag sdedang bcas pa yul khams khridan 'dul ba la bzhag/rgyal bus yar byon te nor rdzas rnams yab rgyal 4 la phul/ slob dpon chen 4 padma'i spyan sngar sdig pa thams cad bshags/rdo rje phur ba'i dbang mnangagango sprod zhus/ nyams su blangs pas phur ba'i zhal mthong/ rgyal 4 yab sras kyidagongs pa mthar phyin te rgyal khams bde ba la bkod do/ /lo rgyus de dang mtshungs pa'i rnam sras sprin gseb mar grags pa gser can lha dgu'i rjes gnang 'bul ba la/ sngon 'phro slob da4na gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ dngos gzhi slob ma'i ngos skal du shar ba la/thog mar gnyen po'i nyaphyagan rdo rje'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍapa phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mtshod cing gsol ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bskyabs pa'i nyid /gsang bdag lubror bcas deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum/ slob ma'i gzhi lus sbyangs phyag rdor du bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa bcug/bum pa sbyi bor bzhag la/ sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi/ /ye shes dam tshig dri ma med/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa 4294
rnam sras gcig lhag lnga'atshonagasum gyi tshab bsgrigagyis/ /bdag gis mngon par dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra pā ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa me/ zhes brjod la bum chu sgyin/ ngo 'o lha la rnam pa bum pa'i chu de sbyo 4 nas zhugs/ rang dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rin chen phyag rgya sgyi sor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/dbu rgyanadabang bskur sbyin par ma tsha ratna mu ku ṭa a lha ṣiñtsa traṃ/rin po che'i cod ban gyisadabu brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon phyag rdor du gsal ba'i zugs dar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng chad pa sogs sgyi dang 'dra/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis rjes zlos ma slobadapon la me tog 'thor zhing] sngags bdag bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /sngags bdag bdag la pyin gyis slobs/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la me tog 'jur zhing] sngags bdag 'di la sogs brjod/ de nas rnam sras kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal pa ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyabs pa'i don gyi mig /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/de nas mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma 'de rnam sras rtenadang brten par bcas par bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa yin pas/ mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa yin 〈sna/ /zhes mtshams skyar nas/ sngar bshad pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams sngar yod gsal btab pa'i tshul gyis tshar cig rgyas par brjod/ slobadapon phyag rdor du gsal ba'i zugs spu'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phyos/ byang phyogs na bzhugs pa'i rnam sras 'khor bcas kyi zugs dar phog rnam sras gshor bcas kyi sku dpag tu med pa 'ur 'ur thib rib byungan mdun bskyed las kyang de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa chadade khyed rang gi sku la rim pas thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing dngos grub ma lus pa stsol pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bai zhes pa'i gsung gdangs ring 4 dang bcas te spos rol bya zhing snying ṭo dang nye snying gi mthag a bai sha ya a āḥbarjod/ de ltar thim 295

rnam sras gcig lhag lnga༄gagasum gyi tshagi bsgri'agan(16)dbang drag 'phrin las sgrub la bstan srung mchog /gsang las yang gsang dpal ldan mdung dmar can/ /rnam mang thos sras myur mgyogs pho nya'i gtso/ /dbang chen rol pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /drag 4 yang gsang mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa 'de'i rjes gnang la rten gtor gru bzhi'i steng mkhar thabs kyi rtser baphyosnas bu gru gsum bzhag pa kha dog dmar por bsgyur/ 'og khu dgos pa'i mdung dmar 4 dang / dung chos sogs su dri bzang gi chu yang bshams/ gzhan yi dam gyi gtor ma dang / 'bul gtor mchod pa rnams spyi dang 'dra/ slob dngon gyis phyag rdor bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sga mdun du phyag rdor spyan drangs pa la gtor ma 'bul ba yang sngar bzhin/ mdun gyi rten gtor la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng ge'i khri rin 4 ches smras pa'i steng du pad zla'i steng du bai yig mtshal gyi mdog lta bu bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ 'jig rten gyi dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus/ bai la rim de 'gangs su gyur pa las rgyal chen rnam thos sras sku mdog padma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku bajid pa'i cha lugs can/ sku la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i bse khrab dmar po dang / dbu la bse'i rmog zhu dar dmar gyi cod pan can/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dar dmar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa na stag smrags kyi rgyal mtshan dang mdung dmar po 'dzin pa/ g.yon ne'u le dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ rgyal 4 rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku dang phyag mtshan las 'od zer dmar 4 lcags kyu lta bu 'phyo bas 'ju ba thams cad dbang du sdud pa/ lubor gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsgom/ bdag mdun 297

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum/ gapas khyab zer na/ btags yod tshos gsum tshang ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i pyid dang po grub ste/ tshad ma'i dmigs pa yod pa'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ don byed nus pa dngos po'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyig gsum pa grub ste/ rtag pa'i mtshan nyid yod pa'i phyigrtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ btags yod chos gsum tshang ba rdzas yod chos gsum tshang ba yin ba'i phyid ma grub na/ btags yod chos gsum tshang ba chos can/ rdzas yod chos gsum tshang ba yin par thal/ mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyis kha cig/shes bya khyod yin/ gzhal bya khyod yin/ yod pa khyodayin na/ khyod shes bya'i bye brag masan pas khyab zer na/ rtag pa chos can/der thal/ de'i pyid ma grub na/ de gsum re re nas tshos can/ rtag pa yin par thal/ khyod dang rtag pa'i gzhi mthun 'dzid pa'i phyir te/ bum pa dang gcig dngan 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha' rnams de yin pa'i phyig kha cig /rtag pa khyod yin/ mi rtag pa khyod yin/ shes bya khyod yin na/ khyod mtshan mtshon gang rung yen pas khyab zer na/ rtag pa kho na dang dngos po kho na gang rung chos can/der thal/de'i phyis dang 4 ma grub na/ rtag pa chos can/ de gang rung yin par thal/ rtag pa kho na yin pa'i pyid gnyis pa ma grub na/ mi rtag pa chos can/de gang rung yin par thal/ dngos po kho na yin pa'i nyid gsum pa sla/ rtsabar 'dod na/ de gang rung yod par thal/ de gang rung mtshan mtshon gang rung yin pa'i phyid 'dod mi nus te/ dang ṭo med pa gang zhig /phyi ma med pa'i phyiskhon re/ rtag pa khon chos can/ khyod dang dngos 4 kho na gang rung yod par thal/ khyod bdag med yin pa'i phyiran ma khyab/'on khyod rang la/ ri bor dwadang khyi mgo rdo ril gang rung yod par thal/'dod pa'i phyid 'dod mi nus te/ de gnyis ka rnam pa thams cad du med nges yin pa'i phyig kha cig/bum pa khyengad yin/bum pa ma yin zhing khyengad yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub na/ stso1da bum pa'i sbyo yin pas khyab zer na/ dngos po kho na chos can/ der thal/ de'i pyid dang 4 sla/ gnyis 408
bsdus grwa'i rnam bzhagpa ma grub na/ bum pa ma yin zhing dngos po kho na yin pa du ma grub par thal/ ka ba de yangade yin/shes pa de yang de yin/ rnam mkhyen de yang de yin pa'i phyid gzhan yang / bum pa dang gcig khyod yin/ bum pa dang gcig ma yin zhing khyod yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub na/ khyod bum pa dang gcig gi sbyi yin pas khyab par thal/ bum pa la de'i phyig 'dod na/ rtag pa kho na chos can/der thal/ de'i pyid dang po ma grub na/ bum pa dang gcig tshog can/ rtag pa kho na yin par thal/rtag pa yin pa'i phyis khyab ste/ rtag pa yin na/ rtag pa kho na yin pas khyab pa'i phyis der thal/dngos 4 yin na/ dngos po kho na yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ bdag med yin pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/ bum pa'i sbyo de yin/ bum pa'i bye brag kyang de yin pa'i phyis kha cig /sgyi khyod yin na/ khyod sbyo yin pas khyab zer na/ sgyi dang gcis chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyid ma grub na/ sgyi chos can/ der thal/ sbyi'i ldog pa yin pa'i phyid ma grub na/ sbyi chos can/ khyod khyod kyi ldog pa yin par thal/ khyod gzhi grub pa'i phyig rtsabar 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod du ma yod par thal/khyod sbyo yin pa'i phyid 'dod na/ sbyo chos can/ khyod dang gcig du ma med par thal/ bdag med yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /spyi dang bye brag gang rung yin na/ mtshan mtshon gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ ka bum gnyis chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyid ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ bye brag yin pa'i phyir te/ shes bya'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir te/ shes bya'i khyab bya yin pa'i phyid gabar 'dod na/ de chos can/ mtshan mtshon gang rung ma yin par thal/ mtshan nyid ma yin pa gang zhig/mtshon bya ma yin pa'i phyig dang po grub lte/ khyod kyi mtshon bya med pa'i phyig gnyis pa grub ste/ yin pa mi srid pa'i shes bya yin pa'i phyir/des na rang lugs la/ btags yod chos gsum tshang ba mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid/btags yod kyi chos gsum yod de/ spyir mtshon bya yin pa/ rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du tshad 409
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum/ gamas grub pa/ rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid las gzhan pa'i chos gzhan gyi mtshon bya mi byed pa dang gsum lasdog /rdzas yod chos gsum tshang ba mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid du lasdog /rdzas yod kyi chos gsum ni/ spyir mtshan nyid yin pa/ rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du tshad mas grub pa/ rang nyid kyi mtshon bya las tshos gzhan gyi mtshan nyid mi byed pa gsum lajog /sbyor mtshon bya de la yangad 'dus byas su gyur pa'i mtshon bya dang / 'dus ma byas su gyur pa'i mtshon bya gnyis yod/dang 4 'dus byas su gyur pa'i mtshon bya de la yangad gzugs su gyur pa'i mtshon ga shes par gyur pa'i mtshon ma ldan min 'du byed du gyur pa'i mtshon bya gsum yod/ dang po gzugs rung gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ gzugs de la dbye na/ gzugs kyi skye mched/ sgra'i skye mched/ dri'i skye mched/ ro'i skye mched/ reg bya'i skye mched dang lnga yod/ mig shes kyi bzung bya gzugs kyi skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ rna shes kyi nyan bya sgra'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ sna shes kyi snom bya dri'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ lce shes kyi phyong bya ro'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ lus shes kyi myong bya reg bya'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa shes pa de la dbye na/ tshad mar gyur pa'i mtshon sgatshad ma ma yin par gyur pa'i de gnyis yod/ gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa tshad ma'i mtshan nyid/gsal zhing rig pa shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ ldan min 'du byed la mtshan nyid langog na/ gzugs shes gang rung du ma gyur pa'i 'du byas ldan min 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid/ spyi bye brag la dbye na/khyab byed sbyi'i mtshan nyid/ bum pa'i khyab byed bum pa'i spyi'i mtshan nyid/ bum pa khyab byed yin pa bum pa sbyo yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ khyab bya bye brag gi mtshan nyid/ bum pa khyab bya yin pa/ bum pa bye brag yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ bum pa'i khyab lga bum pa'i bye brag gi mtshan nyid du lezhug /kha cig /chos de yin na/ chos de'i ldog pa yin pas khyab zer na/ bum pa yin na/ bum pa'i ldog pa yin pas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyig 'dod na/ gser bum chos can/ der thal/ de'i 410
bsdus grwa'i rnam bzhagpyid 'dod na/ de chos can/ bum pa'i ldog pa ma yin par thal/ bum pa dang tha dad yin pa'i pyir te/ bum pa'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /chos de dang gcig yin na/ chos de yin pas khyab zer na/ ka bum gnyis chos can/ ka bum gnyis yin par thal/ ka bum gnyis kyi ldog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ ka bum gnyis dang gcig yin pa'i phyig ma grub na/ ka bum gnyis chos can/ khyod khyod dang gcig yin par thal/ gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ rtsabar 'dod na/ ka bum gnyis chos can/ ka ba yin par thal/ ka bum gnyis yin pa'i phyis gdod mi nus te/ bum pa yin pa'i phyid ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ ka bum gnyis yin pa'i phyid gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ ka ba dang bum pa gnyis ka ma yin par thal/ bdag med yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /skyes la ma 'gag pa da ltar ba'i mtshan nyid/ ma skyes pa ma 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid/ zhig pa ladas pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ dam bca' dang 4 la/ ri 'ong rwa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/mtshon bya de'i phyig ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ skyes la ma zhig pa yin pa'i phyir te/ ma zhig pa yin pa'i phyid rtsabar 'dod na/ de chos can/ yod par thal/ da ltar ba yin pa'i pyid'dod mi nus/ dam bca' gnyis pa la ri 'ong rwa chos can/ skye ba'i rgyu yod kyang ma skyes pa'i cha yin par thal/ skye ba'i rgyu yod kyang ma skyes pa'i pyig der thal/ ma 'ongs pa'i phyir na ma khyab/rtags grub ste/ med nges yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na khyod rang la/ ma 'ongs na ma 'ongs pa yin pas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i pyid medod na/ sgra rtag pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i pyid ma grub na/de chos can/ 'ongs par thal/ ma 'ongs par rtags ma grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/yod par thal/ 'ongs pa'i mig 'dod mi nus te/ med nges yin pa'i sgyig ma grub na/ sgra chos can/ khyod rtag pa med nges yin par thal/ khyod mi rtag pa yin pa'i phyig kha cig /gzhi grub na/da ltar ba yin pas khyab zer na/ bum pa 'das pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyis ma grub na/411
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum/ gade chos can/ der thal/ yod pa'i phyis 'dod na/ bum pa 'das pa chos can/ da ltar ba ma yin par thal/ 'das pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can de dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang/ bum pa rang gi rgyu dus nas ma sleb pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i sgyig medod na/ de chos can/ da ltar ba ma yin par thal/ ma sleb pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ma 'ongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ rtsis dang byas pas/ bum pa rang gi rgyu dus nas ma sleb pa ma 'ongs pa yin par rtags ma grub zer na/ bum pa chos can/ khyod rang gi rgyu dus nas ma sleb pa ma 'ongs pa yin par thal/khyod rang gi rgyu'i dus su ma skyes pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang /bum pa'i dus su bum pa'i rgyu thal ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ 'das pa yin pa'i pyid ma grub na/ bum pa chos can/ khyod kyi dus su khyod kyi rgyu thal ba 'das pa yin par thal/ khyod kyi dus su khyod kyi rgyu thal ba yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ khyod skya dus su khyod kyi rgyu 'gag zin pa yod pa'i pyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ rtsabar 'dod na/ bum pa'i dus su bum pa'i rgyu chos can/ yod par thal/ da ltar ba yin pa'i pyidkhyab ste/ dus gsum gang rung yin na/ yod pas khyab pa'i pyid gzhan yangad bum pa'i dus su bum pa'i 'bras bu chos can/ yod bar thal/ dus gsum gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ ma 'ongs pa yin pa'i phyig ma grub na/ bum pa chos can/ khyod kyi dus su khyod kyi 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa yin par thal/ khyod kyi 'bras bu khyod kyi dus su ladas pa dang ma 'ongs pa gang rung yin pa gang zhig /'das pa ma yin pa'i mig dang 4 grub ste/ dngos 4 yin pa'i phyid gnyis pa ma grub na/de chos can/ khyod kyi dus su khyod kyi 'bras bu 'das pa ma yin par thal/ bdag med yin pa'i pyid gabar gdod na/ bum pa chos can/ khyod kyi 'bus bu khyod kyi dus su med par thal/ khyod bdag med yin pa'i phyis kha cig /chos de'i 'bras bu yin na/ chos de'i dus su med pas khyab 412
bsdusagrwa'i rnam bzhagzer na/ skyes pa'i 'bras bu chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig 'dod na/ skyes pa'i 'bras bu chos can/ khyod yod pa'i dus mi srid par thal/ khyod skyes pa'i dus su khyod med pa gang zhig /khyod ma skyes pa'i dus su khyod med pa'i phyir/ dang 4 ma grub na dngos/ gabar 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod skyes pa'i dus su yod par thal/ dngos sa yin pa'i phyig sa cig /'bras bu yin na/ skyes zin pas khyab zer na/ skye bzhin pa'i 'bras bu chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig der thal/ skye bzhin pa'i 'bras bu yod pa'i pyid der thal/ 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa yod pa'i nyidrtsabar 'dod na/ skye bzhin pa'i 'bras bu bzhag tu med par thal/ de skyes zin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de yod pa'i phyir te/ phal cher skyes la yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu yod pa'i pyid gzhan yang skyes pa'i 'bras bu skyes pa'i dus su yod par thal/ skyes pa'i 'bras bu skyes pa'i dus de/ skyes pa'i 'bras bu skyes pa'i dus yin pa'i phyid ma grub na/ skyes pa'i 'bras bu chos can/ khyod skyes pa'i dus khyod skyes pa'i dus yin par thal/ dngos po yin pa'i phyig kha cig /skyes pa'i 'bras bu med zer na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi 'bras bu yod par thal/ khyod kyi rgyu yod pa'i phyig der thal/ khyod dngos yo yin pa'i phyis rtags grub lte/ skyes pa/ la)ga pa/mi rtag pa gsum ka dngos 4 yin pa'i phyisdes na rang lugs la/ skyes kyang ma zhig pa da ltar ba'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi bum pa lta bu la byed/ rang dus da ltar bar stos te thal ba 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ dper na/bum pa la ltos te thal ba/bum pa'i 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi bum pa'i rgyu ltabu la byed/ dper na/bum pa'i rgyu de bum pa'i 'das pa yin kyangad bum pa 'das pa ma yin/ bum pa 'das pa ni/ bum pa'i ma 'ongs pa yin/ rang dus da lta ba la stos te rgyu yod kyang ma skyes pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid/bum pa la stos te rgyu yod kyang ma skyes pa/bum pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid/ dperan/bum pa'i 413

bsdus grwa'i rnamabazhag legs par bshad pa/'bras yin par thal/ bum pas dngos su skyed par bya ba yin pa'i phyid ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ de bum pa'i dngos 'bras kyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyig ma khyab mtshams la ma grub na/der thal/ bum pa'i 'bras bu gang] khyod dang bum pa'i bar chos gzhan gyis ma chod pa'i phyid de bzhin du bum pa'i snga logs su byung ba'i snga logs su byung ba'i phyi logs su byung ba de bum pa'i dngos rgyu yin kyang / des ma khyab tshul dngad bum pa'i snga logs su byung ba'i phyi logs su byung ba bum pa dang dus mnyam yang/ des ma khyab tshul sogs 'phen/yang kha cig na re/ khyod bum pa'i dngos 'bras yin na khyod yin na bum pa'i 'bras bu dang dngos 'bras gnyis ka yin pas khyab zer na/bum pa'i phyi logs su byung ba'i pyi logs su byung ba'i snga logs su byung ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyis der thal/ khyod bum pa'i 'bras bu gang]khyod dang bum pa'i bar chos gzhan gyis ma chod pa'i phyis rtags gnyis pa grub lte/ chos can de dang gcig yin pa'i phyig gshor gsum/ rtsabar 'dod na/ bum pa'i rgyu chos can/ bum pa'i 'bras bu dang bum pa'i dngos 'bras gnyis ka yin par thal/ bum pa'i pyi logs su byung ba'i phyi logs su byung ba'i snga logs su byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ bum pa'i phyi logs su byung ba'i phyi logs su byung ba khyod kyi 'bras bu ma yin par thal/ khyod bum pa'i pyi logs su byung ba'i phyi logs su byung ba'i snga logs su byung ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/gshor gsum/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod de'i brgyud rgyu yin pa'i phyig ma grub na/bum pa chos can/khyod kyi rgyu khyod kyi phyi logs su byung ba'i phyi logs su byung ba'i brgyud rgyu yin par thal/ khyod khyod kyi pyi logs su byung ba'i pyi logs su byung ba'i brgyud rgyu yin pa'i phyig der thal/ khyod dngos posan pa'i phyis des rigs pa gzhan la rgyur sga tshog la nyakhrin/bum pa chos can/bum padang dus mnyam masan par thal/bum pa'i phyi logs su byung ba'idangos yosan pa'i phyig der 475

bsdus grwa'i rnam bzhag legs par bshad gadang brjod yul snang yul gsum gang rung yod par thal/ khyod yul can yin pa'i phyis gsor gsum/ medod mi nus te/ khyod kyi dmigs yul med pa gang zhig /khyod kyi brjod yuladang khyod kyi snang yul gang yang med pa'i nyid dang bo grub ste/ khyod gang zag dang shes pa gang rung ma yin pa'i sgyid der thal/ bum pa yin pa'i phyig rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ der thal/ khyod sgra dang dbang po drug gang rung ma yin pa'i nyigader thal/ de gang rung mayin pa'i79da pasan pa'i nyidder thal/ chos can dedang gcig yin pa'i phyid gzhan yang/ ka ba chos can/ de gnyisasan par thal/ gzhi grub pa'i phyis khyab pa khas/ der thal/ tshad ma'i grub pa yin pa'i phyig rtsabar 'dod na/ de chos can/ yul can yin par thal/ de gnyis ka yin pa'i phyis lta'or gsum khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod kyi yul med pa'i phyis der thal/ khyod yul med pa'i phyi'i beem bo yin pa'i phyiska ba dang gcig yin pa'i pyid gzhan yang] 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha' chos can/ de gnyis yin par thal/ gzhi grub pa'i phyis khyab pa khas/ der thal/ yod pa yin pa'i phyig 'dod na/ de chos can/ yul can yin par thal/ de gnyis ka yin pa'i pyid gshor gsum/ 'dod na/ yul can ma yin par thal/ med dgag yin pa'i phyig der thal/ chos canade'i sgyig de bzhin du bum pa'i ldog pa sogs kyang 'phen/ yang kha cig na re/ yul yul can gnyis 'gal zer na/ yul yin na yul can ma yin pas khyab par thal/ de gnyis lagal pa'i phyis dngor gsum/ 'dodan/ tshad ma chos can/ yul can ma yin par thal/ yul yin pa'i phyig khyab pa khas/ gshor gsum song]der thal/ blo'i yulasan pa'i phyig der thal/ blo'i yul du bya rungasan pa'i pyig der thal/shes bya yin pa'i phyig khyab lte/ blo'i yul du bya rung shes bya'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyis rnam 'grel las/ shes byar 'dzin phyir med pa la/ /nyes pa dag tu thal mi 'gyud /zhes gsungs pa'i nyidrtsabar gdod na/ tshad ma chos can/ yul can yin par thal/ rjod byed kyi sgra dang shes pa dang gang 477
kun mkhyenagasung 'bum/ gazag gsum gang rung yin pa'i phyis khyab lte/ de gsum la rang rang gi 'jug yul re yod pa'i nyid der thal/rjod byed kyi sgra la rang gi brjod bya'i yul yod pa gang zhig/shes pa dang gang zag gnyis la rang rang gi dmigs yul re dgos pa'i phyid dang po grub ste/ rnam 'grel las/ sgra yi yul dang yul min pag zhes pa'i sgra yi yul dang zhes pa'i don yod pa'i phyig rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ yod na shes pa dang gang zag gnyis lnga'i dmigs yul yin pas khyab pa'i phyid mdzod las/ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid mngon rtogs rgyan las kyang ngo] gzhan yang / tshad ma chos can/ yul can ma yin par thal/ yul yin pa'i phyis der thal/ shes pa'i dmigs yul yin pa'i phyis der thal/ gzhi grub pa'i phyig khyab ste/ gzhi grub dang yod pa dang de gsum don gcig pa'i pyid tshad ma las/ yod pa dmigs pa las gzhan min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir rtsabar 'dod na/ de chos can/ yul can yin par thal/ shes pa yin pa'i phyis der thal/ tshad ma yin pa'i pyid gzhan yang] de chos can/ yul can yin par thal/ khyod kyi yul yod pa'i phyig der thal/ khyod kyi dmigs yul yang yod/ khyod kyi snang yul yang yod/ khyod kyi gzhal bya yang yod/ khyod kyi 'odzin stangs kyi yul yang yod pa'i pyid dang 4 grub ste/ khyod kyidamigs bya'i yul yod pa'i phyig der thal/ khyod shes pa yin pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/ khyod la snang ba'i chos yod pa'i phyig der thal/ khyod don mthun gyi shes pa yin pa'i phyid gsum pa grub ste/ khyod kyi rtogs bya'i chosawend pa'i sgyid der thal/ khyod tshad ma yin pa'i pyid bzhi pa grub ste/ khyod kyi 'dzin ltangs su byas pa'i chos yod pa'i sgyig der thal/ slo don mthun yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ yul can yin na rjod byed kyi sgra dang shes pa dang gang zag gsum ṭo gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ mig dbang chos can/ sgra shes gang zag gsum gang rungasan par thal/ yul canasan pa'i pyid der thal/ de'i yul gzugs kyi skye mched yod 478
bsdus grwa'i rnam bzhag legs par bshad pa/pa'i pyig der thal/ yul can mig dbang rna dbang sna dbang lce dbang lus dbang lnga dang] de lnga'i yul gzugs kyi skye mched/ sgra'i de/ dri'i de/ ro'i de/ reg bya'i skye mched lnga dang gzugs can bcu sku'od pa'i pyid mdzod las/ gzugs can bcu ni bsags pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiggdod mi nus te/ sgra shes gang zag gang yang ma yin pa'i phyig der thal/ dbang 4 gzugs can pa yin pa'i pyid der thal/ mig dbang yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du rna dbang sogs 'phen sla/yang kha cig /sgra yin na/ yul can yin pas khyab zer na/ rol mo'i sbra phal pa tshesnas can/yul can yin par thal/ sgra yin pa'i phyis khyab pa khas/ zhakhor gsum/ der thal/ rol mo'i sgra yin pa'i mig chos can de'i phyis 'dod na/ khyod kyi brjod bya yod par thal/ sgra gang zhig/yul can yin pa'i phyig 'dod na/ rjod byed kyi sgra yin par thal/ khyod brjod bya dang ldan pa'i sgra yin pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/rjod byed ma yin pa'i sgro yin pa'i pyid chos canade dang gcig yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig/brjod byed kyi sgra yin na/ khyod kyi brjod don yod pas khyab zer na/ gang zag rtag pa yin zhes pa'i sgra chos can/ khyod kyi brjod don yod par thal/ khyod rjod byed kyi sgra yin pa'i mig der thal/ khyod gang zag rtag pa rjod par byed pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir/ chos can de'i phyig rtsabar 'dod na/ gang zag rtag pa yin pa yod par thal lo/ 'dod pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ gang zag rtag par ston pa'i sgra yin na/ khyod kyi brjod bya med pas khyab zer na/ gang zag re zhig rtag par ston pa'i mdo chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig khyab pa khas/ rtags grub lte/de yod pa'i gyis der thal/ gang zag rtag gcig rang dbang can du ston pa'i mdo yod pa'i phyir/rtags sla/ rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ de'i brjod bya yod pa'i phyig der thal/ khyod mdo yin pa'i sgyig yang kha cig na re/ yul dang shes bya don gcig kyang yul dang gzhal bya don mi gcig ste/sgra rtag pa'i don spyi de yul dang shes bya gnyis ka yin kyang / gzhal bya ma yin pa'i phyir te/ sgra 479
